name: Summer Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Pick the plant track or the guest track. The plant track covers gardening and nature science, with garden care, farm share help and pest control. The guest track is about helping guests and sharing science, like Science Chats.
who_can_apply: Current high school students, rising freshmen through graduating seniors. You volunteer once a week in June and July. You do at least one shift at Plains Conservation Center or Chatfield Farms.
duration: Once a week, June to July
deadline_text: The page says summer 2026 applications are closed. No 2027 dates are posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online when the summer window opens. Questions: volunteer office email on the program page.
notes: Also on the page: Junior Counselor Program for ages 13 to 15 (1 full week of camp, Monday to Friday 8:30 to 4:30). Also Gardens Teen Leaders, a school year group for teens who finished the summer program. The page gives no exact ages for the summer program. It only says high school.
